findings.title: Stop and join the reader before checking its exceptions
findings.body: Setting deletedAll does not wait for the reader thread's current HTTP request to finish. The assertion can therefore see an empty list and pass even though that in-flight request subsequently fails with the concurrency error this test is meant to catch. Also, if a deletion throws, deletedAll is never set and the reader continues issuing requests after the test exits. Keep a reference to the thread, stop it in a finally block, and join it before asserting on caughtExceptions so all reader failures are observed and the worker cannot leak into subsequent tests.
